entries.name: HAT
entries.what: Hybrid Attention Transformer SR (CVPR23/TPAMI): dual channel+spatial attention, x4 models, strong on fine texture detail vs SwinIR

entries.name: DAT
entries.what: Dual Aggregation Transformer SR (ICCV23): inter/intra-block spatial+channel aggregation, top-tier on texture-heavy benchmarks, lighter than HAT

entries.name: RGT
entries.what: Recursive Generalization Transformer SR (ICLR24): global spatial info at low cost, beats HAT at similar FLOPs - good SR-per-VRAM for 2K/4K maps

entries.name: DRCT
entries.what: Dense-Residual-Connected Transformer SR (NTIRE24): dense residuals in Swin blocks, HAT-competitive at lower params, clean inference script

entries.name: ATD-SR
entries.what: Adaptive Token Dictionary Transformer SR (CVPR24): learnable token dictionary recovers repeating texture structures (fabric/brick/scales)

entries.name: PASD
entries.what: Pixel-Aware Stable Diffusion real-ISR (ECCV24): pixel-aware cross-attention, generates realistic micro-detail (grain/weave/pores)

entries.name: MambaIR
entries.what: State-space (Mamba) image restoration SR (ECCV24): linear complexity vs quadratic attention, near-SOTA on large atlases with less VRAM

entries.name: BSRGAN
entries.what: Blind-degradation GAN SR (ICCV21): shuffled multi-degradation training handles dirty/compressed mixed-source textures, fast single-pass

entries.name: Real-CUGAN ncnn
entries.what: Real-CUGAN as ncnn Vulkan binaries: 5-10x faster than Real-ESRGAN, runs on Intel/AMD/NVIDIA/Apple; strong for stylized textures

entries.name: DreamMat
entries.what: Geometry/light-aware text-to-PBR (SIGGRAPH24): albedo/roughness/metallic via light-aware diffusion, avoids baked shading in albedo

entries.name: Ouroboros
entries.what: Single-step forward/inverse rendering diffusion (ICCV25): rgb2x decomposes photo to normals/albedo/roughness/metallicity; x2rgb re-renders; video-capable

entries.name: StableMaterials
entries.what: Text-to-PBR latent diffusion: tileable basecolor/normal/height/roughness/metallic via diffusers, 4-step LCM variant

entries.name: MaterialMVP
entries.what: Illumination-invariant multi-view PBR diffusion (ICCV25 Highlight, Tencent): reference attention + dual-channel albedo/metallic-roughness

entries.name: Content-Aware Tiles
